characters.description: a 6-year-old Vietnamese boy with short black hair, wearing a blue T-shirt and dark shorts
a kind Vietnamese grandmother with silver hair in a neat bun, round glasses, wearing a brown ao ba ba

scenes.description: A cozy Vietnamese home living room in the afternoon. A boy in a blue T-shirt builds a tall wooden block castle while a grandmother in a brown ao ba ba and glasses holds a basket; blocks tumble.
Same living room. The boy with short black hair sits crying among scattered wooden blocks, holding one block. The silver-haired grandmother kneels beside him, watery-eyed and gentle.
Same living room, warm light. The boy and his grandmother sit together on the floor happily rebuilding the wooden block castle, placing a block on top.
Rainy afternoon in a cozy Vietnamese home. A boy in a blue shirt sits on a mat with a red toy train, hugging it as his grandmother approaches.
The grandmother in a brown ao ba ba and glasses sits quietly in a corner of the mat while the boy looks at her, toy train beside him.
The boy and his grandmother happily play together with the red train and wooden carriage on the mat, a pillow tunnel nearby, rain fading outside.
